title: Will big bands come back?
summary: Both doubt big bands will return in their day because of costs.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Do you think big bands as we knew them, because of course there are always going to be a few around, do you think big bands as we knew them will ever come back? Big bands, four trumpets, four trombones, five reeds and full rhythm section, like the Basie type of thing, do you think it will ever come back?
I don't believe it will in our day, but as the circle turns, I think it will because--but it's a question of where are they going to work.
Yeah, that's it; because the way things are now, they just cost too much.
Too much for that many pieces. Just moving the band, transportation alone is prohibitive, and the salaries, hotel rent.
